title: Brasileirão 2026: Matchday 27 Promises Classics and Surprises
subtitle: Find out where to watch and who faces whom in the matchday that will once again shake up the championship
excerpt: Brasileirão 2026 Matchday 27 features classics and decisive clashes. See where and when to watch the thrilling games, including Coritiba vs.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The 27th round of the 2026 Brazilian Championship is set to feature classic matches that promise to thrill fans. Among the most anticipated clashes, Coritiba faces Athletico-PR, Palmeiras takes on São Paulo, and Flamengo hosts Corinthians. The schedule is already set, with broadcasts on channels such as Premiere, Sportv, Amazon Prime, ge TV, and Globo.

Coritiba vs. Athletico-PR: Curitiba Derby Heating Up

The clash between Coritiba and Athletico-PR takes place on Friday, September 11, at 9 PM (Brasília time). The match will be held at Couto Pereira, in Curitiba. Premiere and Sportv will be responsible for the broadcast, and fans can follow in real-time on the ge website.

Palmeiras vs. São Paulo: Duel at Nubank Parque

Palmeiras, currently in second place in the standings, faces São Paulo on Saturday, September 12, at 6:30 PM (Brasília time). The match will be played at Nubank Parque, in São Paulo, and Premiere will be responsible for the broadcast. Fans can also follow in real-time on the ge website.

Flamengo vs. Corinthians: Clash of Titans at Maracanã

Flamengo, the league leader, hosts Corinthians on Sunday, September 13, at 5:30 PM (Brasília time). The match will be at Maracanã, in Rio de Janeiro, and will be broadcast on ge TV, Globo, and Premiere. Real-time updates are available on the ge website.

Other Matchday 27 Clashes

  • Atlético-MG vs. Fluminense: Saturday, September 12, 4 PM, Arena MRV, Belo Horizonte – Premiere.
  • Grêmio vs. Vasco: Saturday, September 12, 4 PM, Arena do Grêmio, Porto Alegre – Premiere.
  • Chapecoense vs. Internacional: Saturday, September 12, 5 PM, Arena Condá, Chapecó – Premiere, Record, and Cazé TV.
  • Botafogo vs. Bragantino: Saturday, September 12, 8:30 PM, Nilton Santos, Rio de Janeiro – Amazon Prime.
  • Santos vs. Cruzeiro: Saturday, September 12, 9 PM, Vila Belmiro, Santos – Sportv and Premiere.
  • Mirassol vs. Vitória: Sunday, September 13, 4 PM, Maião, Mirassol – Premiere.
  • Bahia vs. Remo: Monday, September 14, 8 PM, Casa de Apostas Arena Fonte Nova, Salvador – Premiere.

How to Follow in Real-Time

For those unable to watch on television networks, the ge website offers the option to follow the game in real-time, with live commentary and minute-by-minute updates.

  1. Coritiba vs. Athletico-PR – 09/11 9 PM – Premiere, Sportv.

  4. Chapecoense vs. Internacional – 09/12 5 PM – Premiere, Record, Cazé TV.
  5. Palmeiras vs. São Paulo – 09/12 6:30 PM – Premiere.
  6. Botafogo vs. Bragantino – 09/12 8:30 PM – Amazon Prime.
  7. Santos vs. Cruzeiro – 09/12 9 PM – Sportv, Premiere.
  8. Mirassol vs. Vitória – 09/13 4 PM – Premiere.
  9. Flamengo vs. Corinthians – 09/13 5:30 PM – ge TV, Globo, Premiere.
  10. Bahia vs. Remo – 09/14 8 PM – Premiere.

With Matchday 27 packed with classic matchups and decisive games, fans have the opportunity to follow the Brasileirão's unfolding action on various channels and in real-time via ge, ensuring they don't miss any moment of the championship.
